title: Konnected
description: Connect and control your Konnected devices using the ESPHome integration
body:
[Konnected](https://konnected.io/) is a member of the Made for ESPHome program.

Konnected devices work locally and integrate seamlessly with the [ESPHome](/integrations/esphome/) integration in Home Assistant. As all connectivity is done locally, status updates and device control from Home Assistant happen instantly.

## Works with Home Assistant certified devices
